note: Wave 2: more Saudi employers for «دليل». Every careersUrl, about line, logo and posting was opened on 2026-11-20 on the company's own site or its own ATS board (no LinkedIn, Indeed, Bayt or Glassdoor; no login; bot checks skipped). verified=false: the company's own site did not open (bot check), so the record is a name the app can recognise, with no about line. 'fields' uses the app's 9 field ids plus new areas (engineering, tourism, health, education, finance, legal, media, gaming); appFields keeps only the app's current ids. fieldsBasis says where the fields come from: careers-page, postings, or business (inferred from what the company does). aliasesAlone: spellings that are also an everyday word, to count only when typed alone (as in companies.ts). Nothing here is a number about a company.
